hotspots.title: Milei-Villarruel rift deepens over Tedeum snub
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei excluded Vice President Victoria Villarruel from the May 25 Tedeum ceremony, escalating internal government tensions. Villarruel's absence and public statements highlight a growing divide within La Libertad Avanza, with implications for the 2027 elections.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes internal power struggle within Argentina's ruling party, framed as a moral and political crisis with potential electoral consequences.

hotspots.title: Trump announces near-final Iran deal amid GOP alarm
hotspots.blurb: President Donald Trump announced a 'largely negotiated' deal with Iran to end hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, drawing sharp criticism from Republican hawks and skepticism from regional allies. The deal's terms remain contentious, with implications for U.S. foreign policy and the 2026 midterms.
hotspots.affect: This dominates coverage due to its geopolitical stakes, Trump's framing as a diplomatic triumph, and the polarized reactions from U.S. politicians and international observers.

hotspots.title: Poland's false alarm raids spark political firestorm
hotspots.blurb: Poland's security services conducted raids on the homes of President Karol Nawrocki's family and other right-wing figures following false emergency alarms. The opposition PiS party accuses the government of orchestrating a political provocation, while Prime Minister Donald Tusk dismisses the claims as cynical.
hotspots.affect: This story is charged due to its framing as a deliberate attack on political opponents, raising concerns about state overreach and democratic backsliding in Poland.

hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to gain traction in polls, with leaders like Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla positioning the party for potential coalition roles. The AfD's rise has sparked debates about democratic norms and the 'firewall' against far-right collaboration.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the AfD's growing influence, its controversial policies, and the broader European shift toward far-right politics.

hotspots.title: Vox’s rise in working-class strongholds
hotspots.blurb: Spain's far-right Vox party has made significant inroads in working-class districts, particularly in Andalusia, by leveraging grievances over immigration, crime, and economic stagnation. The party's growing influence is reshaping coalition dynamics ahead of regional and national elections.
hotspots.affect: This story is charged due to Vox's polarizing rhetoric, its impact on Spain's political landscape, and the broader European trend of far-right parties gaining ground in traditional left-wing areas.
